text:
Mike: Tiny hypothetical — you're stranded on a TINY island & can bring exactly one non-luxury item that will actually be useful. No teleporters, no satellite phone. What do you bring?

Sophia: Duct tape. Always. :+1:

Devon: Multi-tool (Leatherman). Fix stuff, cut, open, etc.

Jay: Solar charger + battery pack — keep lights/phone if you can scavenge one. (But questionable: is that "non-luxury"?) :sun_with_face:

Linh: Fire starter + flint. Real survival move.

Mike: @Sophia love the classic answer. Follow-up poll in thread? :grin:

Sophia: Yes please — my runner-up would be an inflatable tarp.

Devon: Honorable mention: fishing line + hooks (but that's technically multiple items)...

Jay: Joke entry: portable espresso maker. Can't survive without it :coffee:

ops-bot: Poll created — options: Duct tape / Multi-tool / Solar charger / Flint / Inflatable tarp / Fishing kit

Mike: okay final tiebreaker vote. I pick multi-tool. Practical > espresso (for now) :wink:

Sophia: voting Duct tape

Devon: voting Multi-tool

Linh: voting Flint

Jay: voting Solar charger (but also want espresso)

ops-bot: Poll results: Multi-tool 2, Duct tape 1, Flint 1, Solar charger 1, Inflatable tarp 0, Fishing kit 0

Mike: Multi-tool wins! Thanks for indulging the watercooler thought experiment. New question next week? :sparkles:
